name: publish_grammar
description: Validate a lani.grammar/v0 page of the grammar book and publish it to the app: a new page, or a page again with your examples or a clearer explanation ("more") added. Under a curated page's id it extends that page (the curated text stays; your examples are marked yours). Returns validation errors instead of publishing if invalid. Load the lani-studio skill before using. Say the learner {learner} and what agrees with them {m:…|f:…} (companion/SCENES.md, the learner in the content).
